queries.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%'

driver_report.query_boundary: fresh query initialization, index construction, full typed result materialization; excludes load, serialization, canonical set comparison and result drop; duckdb_1_median_ms includes prepare/optimization and Arrow result materialization; duckdb_1_execute_median_ms prepares once untimed and times execution plus Arrow result materialization (MiniLinq plans at compile time)
driver_report.sf_0_1_gate: all freshly compiled query/configuration workers checked before timing either scale
